standard.summary: 根据输入分辨率自动调整 batch size，保持显存使用恒定。高分辨率时自动降低 batch，低分辨率时允许更大 batch。
standard.effect: resolution_aware_batch_base_resolution 指定参考分辨率（如 1024）。resolution_aware_batch_max_factor 控制最大 batch 放大倍数。resolution_aware_batch_min_factor 控制最小 batch 缩小倍数。
standard.whenToUse: 多分辨率训练时。不想手动调整 batch size 时。
standard.avoidWhen: 固定分辨率训练时不需要。

standard_en.summary: Adjusts the batch size automatically from the input resolution to keep VRAM use constant. It lowers the batch at high resolution and allows a larger one at low resolution.
standard_en.effect: resolution_aware_batch_base_resolution names the reference resolution (1024, say). resolution_aware_batch_max_factor caps how far the batch may grow. resolution_aware_batch_min_factor caps how far it may shrink.
standard_en.whenToUse: In multi-resolution training. When you would rather not adjust the batch size by hand.

advanced.principle: 监控当前 batch 的平均分辨率，与 base_resolution 比较。如果当前分辨率 > base，则降低 batch size 以保持显存恒定。如果当前分辨率 < base，则增加 batch size 以充分利用显存。max_factor 和 min_factor 控制调整范围。
advanced.intervention: training_step 开始时计算分辨率比例 → 调整 batch size → 执行训练。
advanced.expectedImpact: 显存使用更稳定。避免因分辨率变化导致 OOM。
advanced.tradeoffs: batch size 变化可能影响收敛速度。需要配合 learning rate 调整。

advanced_en.principle: Monitors the current batch's average resolution and compares it to base_resolution. If the current resolution > base, batch size is lowered to keep VRAM constant; if lower, batch size is raised to use the VRAM fully. max_factor and min_factor bound the adjustment range.
advanced_en.intervention: At the start of training_step, computes the resolution ratio → adjusts batch size → runs training.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: More stable VRAM usage; avoids OOM from resolution changes.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Batch size changes can affect convergence speed; pair with learning rate adjustments.
